decision.title: SEC public fails-to-deliver market-activity source
decision.summary: Authorize the official SEC Fails-to-Deliver half-month archives as a read-only observational settlement-failure evidence family. FTD quantity is modeled as an aggregate net balance outstanding as of settlement date, not daily flow. PIT availability uses first-observed time for live captures and marks historical publication time uncertain. Capture is not admission. No naked-short inference.

alternatives.name: SEC_FTD_SEPARATE_EVIDENCE_FAMILY
tradeoffs: Publication lag limits live confirmation utility.
Requires careful balance-not-flow semantics in all derived features.

alternatives.name: INFER_FTD_FROM_THRESHOLD
tradeoffs: Would conflate threshold membership with published FTD balances.

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: This ADR does not authorize automatic admission, naked-short labeling, squeeze score changes, predictive model training, or commercial CUSIP redistribution.

positive: Published aggregate FTD balances become queryable with PIT-safe availability clocks.
FTD remains separate from short interest, short-sale flow, and threshold status.
Official SEC source requires no credentials.
negative: Twice-monthly publication lag reduces contemporaneous signal value.
Historical publication timestamps are uncertain without live observation metadata.
